integrity: Self-contained analytical proof and reproducible exact-rational finite checks; no independent scientific audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact homogeneous local public-goods game on simple paths; all results optimize only over specialized Nash equilibria. No comparison with unrestricted Nash-welfare optima. Finite verifier does not prove infinite theorem. Novelty comparison is literature-based, not independent certification.
title: Two universal welfare thresholds for specialized public-goods equilibria on a path
